The '''Kuratooine quarry complex''' was a group of buildings overlooking a played-out quarry on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]]. [[Wraith Squadron]], a recently reformed [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit, used it as a field [[Wraith Headquarters (Kuratooine)|base]]<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref> in [[44 ABY]]<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> as they were hunting down Galactic Alliance [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]], who they lured to Kuratooine and exposed.<ref name="MK" />
